# Borealis rollout overview

The first phase is a 10% cooling pilot, with an explicit review after 24 hours.
Acceptance requires median latency at most 42 ms and p95 latency at most 80 ms.
The operations guide defines the pause condition; it is not permission for automatic expansion.
